findings.message: `proj.ga4.events_*` matches every shard, but comparing `_TABLE_SUFFIX` with a subquery can't limit which shards are read, so the query reads all of them (750 GB in all).
findings.fix: Add a filter on `_TABLE_SUFFIX`, for example `_TABLE_SUFFIX >= FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY))`, or name fewer shards with a longer prefix.
